name: Quick Margarita 1:1:1 CBD/CBG/THC Gummies [10 pack] | 100mg
description:
1:1:1 CBG/CBD/THC 

Per Package: 100mg CBG, CBD & THC 

Per Piece: 10mg CBG, CBD & THC 

With a mouth-watering burst of lime (and a hint of salt), these first-of-their kind fast-acting gummies contain 10mg each of CBD, THC, and CBG – a rare cannabinoid that elevates the stress-relieving neurotransmitter GABA. The result is a uniquely social and creative high, perfect for hangover-free fun.
